claims.text: Company admin can use the Protected Microsoft 365 Objects report to monitor M365 data protection [1][7]
Integration available for VB365 v6+; reporting, job management and restore require v7+ [1]
Report examines whether protected M365 objects are compliant with SLA target [2][7]
Report covers users, groups, sites and teams meeting/breaching SLA [4]
Details section lists object name, restore points, job name/destination, successful sessions, server name, SLA %, schedule in UTC [4]
Reports sent by email as PDF attachments, manually or on a configured schedule [2][7]

A.notes: Omits the requirement of at least one managed Veeam product.

claims.text: VSPC provides the Protected Microsoft 365 objects report to monitor efficiency of VB365 data protection [1],[2]
Report analyzes whether M365 objects are compliant with SLA target [4],[6]
Report examines SLA compliance for Users, Groups, Sites, Teams [5]
Report Details shows backup status, restore points, successful sessions, SLA %, job schedules [3]
Integration with VB365 available starting from VSPC version 6.0 [15]
VB365 provides detailed reports as email attachments for backup jobs [13]
VB365 User Protection reports show protected/unprotected user accounts [14]
VB365 provides Mailbox Protection Reports [18]

B.notes: Sources [1]/[5] are an invoicing/licensing excerpt that does not mention the report; VB365 version requirement and VSPC email/PDF delivery missing.

claims.text: With DHCP, Veeam Agent configures network automatically; nmtui for manual config [5][6]
Select Configure network in Recovery Media main menu [5][6]
Edit a connection in NetworkManager [5][6]
Activate new connection; modified connection must be deactivated then activated [5][6]
Press Esc to return to main menu [5][6]
Mount shared folder step appears when restoring from network shared folder [1][2]
Select SMB (CIFS) type [1][2]
Path in SERVER/DIRECTORY format [1][2]
Domain, Username, Password of account with access permissions [1][2]
Veeam Agent mounts share to /media of recovery image OS file system [1][2]
Several shared folders can be mounted via Add shared folder; name, type, mount point displayed [1][2]
Veeam Agent supports mounting SMB shares to /media of the recovery image OS file system [1]
Recovery Media supports adding a network shared folder via 'Add shared folder' [7]
The Mount Shared Folder dialog described is for NFS shared folder settings [15]

B.notes: Says networking and SMB mount settings are not described although its own source [1] lists the SMB fields; most gold missing.
